'''Pavan Silar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked as a courier for the [[Biological Control Bureau]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateScientistHumanMale.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Pavan Silar]]
Pavan Silar was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].

Although Pavan Silar's appearance was randomized during each quest, he consistently appeared as a Human male under the game's scientist spawn template.
